roleCatalog.defaultScopeBehavior: Use the supplied value only when it is present and contained in allowedScopeTypes. Null or absent requires explicit selection when assignmentRequired is true.
roleCatalog.failurePolicy: Reject the complete catalog for malformed policy, an unknown role, or a defaultScope outside allowedScopeTypes.

userType: optional descriptive metadata only; H3 omits it on create and never derives role, access, or scope from it
capabilities: role and scope selection from H1 metadata
one-time H2 temporary-password and TOTP provisioning presentation
profile, lifecycle, sessions, MFA status, administrator TOTP setup/reset/remove, access review, and audit presentation

globalScope.executiveManagement: H1 returns allowedScopeTypes GLOBAL and defaultScope GLOBAL and enforces the assignment

createUser.requestUserType: omitted by H3; optional backend descriptive metadata defaults to OTHER
createUser.browserInterpretation: The active account is still blocked from normal application access until the required password change completes.

administratorMfa.qr: generated locally from the exact returned otpauth URI
administratorMfa.closeBehavior: clear transient provisioning state and reload safe MFA status

failurePolicy: Missing, malformed, unavailable, or unknown H1 role metadata disables assignment and scope mutation; invalid provisioning invariants suppress provisioning success; production never substitutes the development fixture catalog.
developmentFixture: DEV-only resolver plus explicit isolated test-harness enable flag
secretHandling: Add User bootstrap and administrator setup/reset provisioning are mapped only to transient component state and cleared when their provisioning panel closes; they are never written to storage, URL/history state, logs, or analytics
remainingExternalBoundaries: Native Parking device and native application ownership are outside H3.
APT terminal and device-bound authorization ownership are outside H3.
